title: billing.credit (proposal, ask B-RF1)
description: Proposed comm Function for stapel-billing over services.credit(): service-to-service wallet credit. idempotency_key is REQUIRED (at-least-once delivery; a retry returns the original transaction). source mirrors LotSource, type mirrors TransactionType. Returns {ok: bool, transaction_id: str, balance: int, reason?: str}. Until billing ships it, the billing_credit strategy keeps rewards pending with last_error.
